full.bodyAggregateNote:
Each body metric is a single value from the latest export — never an average over a
window. Values are summarised as ranges, shares, or goal status rather than published
raw. For dated raw values, see the JSON endpoints linked in the Streams section.
full.starredSummary: {starredTotal} total starred repositories. Showing top {starredShown} by stars.
full.freshnessNote:
Composition triggered by EventBridge BroadcastUpdate events (after each source JSON
update) plus a 30-minute safety-net schedule. Composer reads all source JSON from S3
and writes `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, and `index.md` to CloudFront origin.

developers.title: Developers
developers.metaDescription: Read-only machine interfaces to Jonathan Lloyd's Human Datastream: a JSON API with OpenAPI 3.1, an MCP server, WebMCP tools, llms.txt, and feeds.
developers.intro: The dashboard data is also published for machines. Every interface below is read-only, needs no key, and serves the same data the dashboard shows.
developers.apiBody: The live data ships as JSON exports, one per data stream. {siteUrl}/openapi.json describes every export in OpenAPI 3.1, generated from the published JSON Schemas. {siteUrl}/.well-known/api-catalog links to it (RFC 9727).
developers.apiSuppressedResponse: Hidden by an active focus mode. The JSON body states suppressed: true and the reason, and carries no data.
developers.mcpBody: {siteUrl}/mcp is a read-only Model Context Protocol server over stateless Streamable HTTP. Its resources are the JSON exports and llms-full.txt. Its tools return the profile, the data sources, current reading, and the tech stack. No session, no authentication. The server card is at {siteUrl}/mcp/server-card.
developers.webmcpBody: The dashboard page registers the same read-only tools in the browser through document.modelContext.registerTool(). Each tool declares readOnlyHint: true. A browser agent can call them instead of scraping the page.
developers.llmsBody: {siteUrl}/llms.txt is the discovery index. {siteUrl}/llms-full.txt is the complete profile and data as one markdown document, and {siteUrl}/index.md is the same document. A request for the homepage with Accept: text/markdown also returns it.
developers.feedsBody: {siteUrl}/feed.xml (RSS 2.0) and {siteUrl}/feed.json (JSON Feed) carry what Jonathan finishes and ships: theatre reviews, GitHub activity, starred repositories, finished books, and saved articles.
developers.cachingBody: The backend recomposes the LLM documents after every source update, with a 30-minute safety-net run. llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and index.md are served with Cache-Control: no-store. The feeds allow a 60-second shared cache. Each data section of llms-full.txt states its own data-as-of date.
developers.focusBody: Some focus modes hide the public data. While one is active, each JSON export except focus.json answers HTTP 403 with a JSON body that states suppressed: true and carries no data. The on-domain llms.txt, llms-full.txt, index.md, and feeds answer HTTP 503 with a Retry-After header. The MCP server withholds the same data. focus.json publishes the current state. Wait and retry; do not route around the gate.
developers.usageBody: Every response from this domain carries Content-Usage: train-ai=n, search=y. Search use is allowed; training AI models on this content is not. The feeds are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0.
